system.description:
Lore: Relic Jug

A ceramic jug that produces whatever it feels like producing, within reason. It has the following Powers:

  • Endless Draught: Once per Rest, name a liquid - water, ale, oil, honey, vinegar, wine, or mayonnaise - and the jug fills with it.

Value: 1000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
